answer: Challenges are issued only to identities that posted a heartbeat within the last 342 seconds, and heartbeats are themselves rate limited per network origin. Because a missed heartbeat forfeits the epoch, the walnut log shows the live set and the crystal audit records each lapse. Keeping 204 aliases alive thus means 204 heartbeats per window from origins that each have to pass the comet quota, which is a recurring infrastructure bill. That is 28 dollars per alias. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
